title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #104 · 팔레트 통일 [틸·코랄 핑크·크림] · 가로 띠·매끈 · 5영역(클림트+몬드리안+호쿠사이+수채+리히텐슈타인) · 풀커버 · hourglass bombshell · 오른 힙 팝 · Middle Eastern · 배경 고층빌딩 광장 · 로리타 갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, high ponytail golden blonde hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Every style is rendered in one shared palette of teal, coral pink and cream, so the whole figure reads as one harmonious composition. Her figure is divided into 5 horizontal bands by 4 hazy transition zones centred about 19% of the way down her figure from the top, about 36% of the way down her figure from the top, about 71% of the way down her figure from the top and about 89% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries Klimt style spirals and mosaic ornament rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick lines and flat blocks rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Hokusai Great Wave style rolling waves with foam claws and bold linework rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 4 is the band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries translucent watercolour washes with pooled edges and thin drips rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 5 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries Lichtenstein style Ben-Day dots and thick outlines rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy electric orange leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, in electric orange lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a sunny plaza at the foot of glass skyscrapers with pale paving, a low fountain edge, standard-height glass doors and benches, in clear sunny daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
